_note: Single registry of every playlist. id=null means the playlist must be created on first run, then the id saved here. Order: 'forward' or 'reversed'. mode: how automation may touch it.

air_order.title: DJ Stace library show Air Order

working.title: DJ Stace library show working

weekly.title: Stace's Weekly Playlist
